name: How do I know if my roof has hail damage?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my roof has hail damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of hail damage can include dimples or indentations on soft metals like gutters and vents, chipped or bruised shingles, and granule loss resulting in exposed asphalt. After a significant hail storm, it's recommended to have a professional inspection, as some damage isn't visible from the ground or immediately apparent. We offer free, no-obligation inspections in the DFW service area to help homeowners identify potential hail damage promptly.
